title.zh: 强对流环境：从参数判别到时空结构
title.en: Severe-storm environments: beyond a winning parameter

subtitle.zh: 第 1 期 · 专题阅读周报。围绕环境表征、风暴移动与预报可用性，重读三篇研究。覆盖时间指本期阅读整理周期，论文不限于本周发表。
subtitle.en: Issue 1 · A thematic reading issue on environmental representation, storm motion and forecast-time availability. The window describes this reading edition, not publication dates.

thread.zh: 参数能区分已有风暴的类型，并不等于能预测风暴是否发生。比较论文结论时，还需要对齐环境廓线、风暴移动来源和信息可得时刻。
thread.en: Discriminating among storms is not the same as predicting their occurrence. Comparing studies also requires aligning environmental profiles, storm-motion sources and information availability.

note.zh: 依据现有论文知识卡编排；各条目保留 Claim 与章节定位。本期跨论文联系为阅读综合，不代表作者共同结论。音频为已有相关专题节目，并非本期逐篇周报录音；未设置自动发布。
note.en: Prepared from existing paper cards, with Claim and section anchors. Cross-paper connections are editorial synthesis. Audio is a related existing episode, not a recording of this weekly issue. Automatic publication is not configured.

title.zh: 本期速览 · 阅读摘要

note.zh: 先看“本期线索”，再读 Coffer 的移动估计对照与 Chavas 的廓线实验。速览音频尚未录制。
note.en: Start with the thread above, then the motion comparison in Coffer and the profile experiments in Chavas. A short audio introduction has not been recorded.

note.zh: 英语合成语音 · 环境判别与风暴发生的区别。完整逐字稿在播客页面。
note.en: Synthesized English narration · environmental discrimination versus storm occurrence. The full transcript is on the podcast page.

title.zh: 超级单体环境：解释不同龙卷数据集之间的分歧
title.en: Supercell Environments Using GridRad-Severe and the HRRR: Addressing Discrepancies between Prior Tornado Datasets

priority.zh: 重点精读 · 数据构建影响

summary.zh: 用 GridRad-Severe 识别的超级单体和 HRRR 入流环境，检验浅层与深层 SRH 判别结果为何随数据集改变。
summary.en: Uses GridRad-Severe supercells and HRRR inflow environments to investigate why shallow- versus deep-layer SRH discrimination changes across datasets.

findings.zh: 在该数据集中，用观测移动替换 Bunkers 估计，改变了 SRH 深度的技巧排序，SRH3 超过 SRH500。
findings.en: Within this dataset, replacing Bunkers estimates with observed motion reverses the depth ranking, with SRH3 outperforming SRH500.

findings.zh: 作者对预报应用保留条件：缺乏先验移动信息时，浅层 SRH 与估计移动仍可能更合用。
findings.en: The authors qualify forecast use: without prior motion information, shallow-layer SRH with estimated motion may remain more useful.

reason.zh: 它把“结论不同”转化为可比较的数据构建选择，适合研究环境指标的时空依赖。
reason.en: It connects apparently conflicting conclusions to observable dataset-construction choices.

relevance.zh: 为强对流环境时空分析提供两条比较轴：移动估计方式，以及距事件的时间窗口。
relevance.en: Provides two comparison axes for spatiotemporal analysis: motion estimation and the time window relative to an event.

path.zh: 先读 §5 与 Table 1 的移动对照，再读 §6 的预报适用条件与未决问题。
path.en: Read the motion comparison in §5 and Table 1, then the forecast qualifications and open questions in §6.

limits.zh: 观测移动可能包含风暴发展后的信息；偏移移动是原因还是结果仍未解决。不同资料不能直接当作环境真值。
limits.en: Observed motion can include information arriving during storm development. Whether deviant motion is a cause or effect remains open, and a model analysis is not automatically environmental ground truth.

title.zh: 强对流环境探空的理想化物理模型
title.en: An Idealized Physical Model for the Severe Convective Storm Environmental Sounding

priority.zh: 方法精读 · 完整廓线

summary.zh: 建立可独立调整边界层与自由对流层的理想化探空模型，并用数值实验考察整体参数未表达的垂直结构。
summary.en: Builds an idealized sounding model with adjustable boundary-layer and free-tropospheric structure, then tests information missed by bulk parameters.

findings.zh: 具有相近 SBCAPE 和低层整体切变的环境，在所展示实验中产生了持续时间不同的风暴。
findings.en: Environments with similar SBCAPE and low-level bulk shear produce different storm lifetimes in the illustrated experiments.

findings.zh: 修改低层水汽或自由对流层湿度后，理想化环境可以恢复持续超级单体。
findings.en: Changing low-level moisture or free-tropospheric humidity can restore a sustained supercell in the idealized environment.

reason.zh: 说明相近的指数值不意味着相近的完整环境，提供保存与分析廓线的直接动机。
reason.en: Shows why similar index values do not imply equivalent environments, motivating complete-profile analysis.

relevance.zh: 环境时空聚类可保留水汽与浮力的垂直结构，随后检查它们是否提供整体参数之外的信息。
relevance.en: Spatiotemporal clustering can retain moisture and buoyancy profiles, then test their information beyond bulk parameters.

path.zh: 先读 §3.4 的实验比较，再回看模型定义；最后核对作者关于归因范围的说明。
path.en: Start with the experiments in §3.4, revisit the model definition, and check the limits on attribution.

limits.zh: 这些示例实验不用于划定稳健敏感性，也不能把行为差异干净归因到某一个廓线特征。
limits.en: The illustrative experiments do not establish robust sensitivities or isolate a single profile feature as the cause.

title.zh: 由 RUC 获取的超级单体近邻探空
title.en: Close Proximity Soundings within Supercell Environments Obtained from the Rapid Update Cycle

priority.zh: 基础回读 · 判别样本

reading.zh: 已有知识卡 · 章节锚点

summary.zh: 以模式分析探空建立风暴近邻样本，比较超级单体类别之间的环境参数，并讨论 SCP、STP 的适用范围。
summary.en: Constructs a proximity-sounding sample from model analyses, compares environments across storm classes and discusses SCP and STP applicability.

findings.zh: 低层湿度和切变在样本内具有判别信息；STP 阈值是基于特定样本的使用指引。
findings.en: Low-level moisture and shear provide discrimination within the sample; the STP threshold is a sample-based guideline.

findings.zh: 作者提醒：组合参数依赖对流模态判断，不能当作脱离条件的“魔法数字”。
findings.en: The authors caution that composite parameters depend on convective-mode prediction and are not magic numbers.

reason.zh: 回到常用参数的建样方式，能看清后续研究沿用了哪些前提。
reason.en: Revisiting how familiar parameters were developed makes their inherited assumptions visible.

relevance.zh: 设计时空事件样本时，应区分风暴类型判别与环境中事件发生率的估计。
relevance.en: When constructing spatiotemporal samples, distinguish storm-type discrimination from estimating event occurrence in the environmental population.

path.zh: 重点读 §2 的筛选、§4d 的参数与样本内技巧，以及 §3a 的探空误差边界。
path.en: Read sample selection in §2, parameters and dependent-sample skill in §4d, and sounding-error qualifications in §3a.

limits.zh: 样本内的阈值表现不是独立预报验证；观测站附近的误差评估也未覆盖所有离站环境。
limits.en: Dependent-sample threshold performance is not independent forecast verification; errors near observation sites do not establish off-site fidelity.

text.zh: 从近邻探空到观测移动对照，资料和估计方式逐渐成为解释判别结果的显式条件。关联：Coffer C4、Thompson C10。
text.en: Proximity soundings and motion comparisons make data and estimation choices explicit conditions of discrimination. Links: Coffer C4; Thompson C10.

text.zh: 完整廓线有信息，但哪个层次、哪种结构在什么条件下起作用，仍需有控制的实验。关联：Chavas C11。
text.en: Profiles contain information, but controlled experiments are still needed to isolate which structures matter under which conditions. Link: Chavas C11.

title.zh: 下一步：按可得时刻比较

text.zh: 阅读综合建议：在同一事件集内区分预报时可得移动与事后移动，再比较不同提前量下的 SRH 深度排序。
text.en: Editorial proposal: separate forecast-available and retrospective motion on the same events, then compare SRH-depth rankings across lead times.

title.zh: “判别好”与“预测好”需要不同验证
title.en: Discrimination and prediction need different verification

text.zh: 阅读参数论文时，先确定样本是否已经以风暴发生为条件，再解释技巧。可从 Thompson 的样本内阈值讨论开始。
text.en: Before interpreting skill, establish whether the sample is conditioned on storm occurrence. Start with Thompson’s dependent-sample threshold discussion.
